label: hexInSwapsRedBlue: a picked hex color reaches the Flare scene with red and blue swapped
replace: self = FlareColor(r: color.b, g: color.g, b: color.r)

label: hexInRefusesEveryColor: the bridge reads a valid hex color as none, so the pick is dropped
hexOutSwapsRedBlue: a Flare color shows in the color row with red and blue swapped
hexOutAlwaysFallsBack: the getter skips the clamped channels and reads every color as the white fallback
